explanation.explanation: The y-axis plots the GSEA 'Enrichment score (ES)', a dimensionless, standardized running-sum statistic (analogous to a normalized/standardized score), so no physical units are required.

The x-axis represents the rank-ordered gene list from T11b-high to T11b-low (a ranked/ordinal position with an accompanying rank-metric color bar), which is an ordinal/categorical axis rather than a physical measurement, so no units are required.
The y-axis is labeled 'Log2 (fold change)', a log ratio/fold-change measure, which does not require units per convention.
The x-axis lists individual gene names (Klk14, Tgm3, Sprr2d, Krt16, Il1f9, S100a7a, Plat, Sprr2h), a categorical variable that does not require units.
